description: This PHP source file defines the OverlapLeaveModel class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin API. It models leave overlaps, extending the LeaveModel class, and includes methods for converting leave data into an array suitable for APIs, incorporating details like comments and time attributes.

classes.name: OverlapLeaveModel
classes.description: A model class representing overlapping leave entries with additional properties such as last comments, designed for API responses, extending the base LeaveModel class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the OverlapLeaveModel with a Leave entity instance.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the leave data into an array, including last comment details if available.
